title: The review tool has a written contract for what Garura sends it and what comes back
The review tool runs as a server that keeps every review action as a numbered event
A person can read a review: the whole model's approval state, each intent with its ICE, and the product
A person can answer a review in the page or one card at a time: comment, edit, remove, accept, send back, drop
Every piece of the product model carries its approval state: approved, changed or in progress
Agents build only from approved pieces
Decide how approval is recorded outside the review step
Garura opens a review on what a drive changed and records every answer on the drive's branch
A sent-back piece comes back reworked, with Garura's reply on the comment
The drive's last step applies the review's answers in one commit and writes approval
